tasks.description: In contents/docs/slack/setup.mdx, the 'Connect Slack to your project' step only points users to Settings → Integrations. Add a note that Slack can also be connected from the shareable landing page at /integrations/slack (the new IntegrationsLanding scene), which shows the logo, description, capabilities, and a single Connect button and flips to a success view after the OAuth round-trip.

In contents/docs/session-replay/integrations.mdx, the 'Setting up integrations' section says to go to project settings to connect Linear/GitHub/GitLab/Jira. Mention the new per-integration landing pages at /integrations/<slug> (slugs: linear, github, gitlab, jira) as an alternative shareable connect entry point that shows connection status and a connect action.

In contents/docs/error-tracking/integrations.mdx, the Jira (and other) setup steps only reference Error tracking settings. Add that the same integrations can be connected from the shareable /integrations/<slug> landing page, which shows connection status and a connect button.

What does the new landing scene and route actually expose to users (URL, layout, connect flow)?

What slugs and docsUrl values are defined for each integration, and does the landing page expose a shareable URL worth documenting?
